description: List the tables and columns staged on a canvas by chembl_get_bioactivities — inspect before calling chembl_dataframe_query to write correct SQL. Returns each table with its row count, kind (table | view), and column names + types. Requires CANVAS_PROVIDER_TYPE=duckdb.

canvas_id.description: Canvas ID returned by chembl_get_bioactivities (spilled: true).

name: chembl_dataframe_describe

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `canvas_disabled`: Called while CANVAS_PROVIDER_TYPE is not duckdb, so no canvas exists. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

tables.description: Tables and views staged on the canvas.

items.description: One staged table or view on the canvas.

columns.description: Columns available for SQL on this table.

kind.description: Whether the entry is a base table or a registered view.

row_count.description: Number of rows in the table (materialized COUNT for views).

title: chembl-dataframe-describe
